name: Cubers East India Open 2017

venue.name: Golf Green Phase - II AOA (Apartment Owners' Association) Community Hall

information: PLEASE go through all the information given on the website, before you register and before mailing us with your questions. Online registrations begin on September 1, 2016 and end on January 5, 2017 at 23:59:59 hrs. On Spot Registrations (at the venue on competition day) will be charged extra and will be limited, hence we encourage all participants to register online.
